root_cause.summary: The fast-entry check requires execution_contract.allowed_writes to equal the four-path owner route scope, while the plan-once admission check requires the same field to equal the three material writes and excludes the terminal receipt path.

contradictory_requirements.requirement: execution_contract.allowed_writes must cover and be covered by the route write scope: three material paths plus the terminal Task Session receipt.
execution_contract.allowed_writes must equal mutation-admission materialWrites: the three material paths only.
The terminal Task Session receipt must instead be the sole executionOutput, and allowedWrites must be the union of materialWrites and executionOutputs.

root_cause.runner_diagnostic: fast-entry request and receipt do not bind this governance route

affected_invariant: A valid plan-once selected-unit request must be able to preserve the material-write versus execution-output partition while also proving exact owner-route write closure.

minimal_repair_proposal.change: Validate the fast-entry route scope against the normalized union of plan material writes and the terminal receipt execution output, while preserving the later material-only equality check for execution_contract.allowed_writes.
minimal_repair_proposal.regression_case: A route containing three material paths and one terminal receipt must admit a request whose execution writes contain only the three material paths and whose closeout terminal receipt supplies the fourth path.

required_revalidation: Run the canonical Task Session governance-runner regression suite.
Regenerate the installed .agents/skills/task-session package from canonical Arcanum source.
Verify canonical and generated runner hashes are identical.
Create a fresh SWU-CAL-001 Task Session attempt and fresh mutation admission.
Re-run governance-runner prepare and prove single-use admission consumption.
Run the exact acceptance-critical command against live product paths only after prepare admits mutation.
Re-run terminal-receipt semantic validation before closeout.
stop_reason: The repair is outside the frozen WP-CAL-TEN-L0 product write boundary and cannot be inferred from the existing execution authorization.
